Budget-Conscious.strategy:
**What makes them unique:** Budget-Conscious users spend mindfully but often miss higher-yield savings opportunities despite having the discipline for them.

**Features to build:**
  • Auto-invest surplus: sweep end-of-month balance into a liquid fund automatically.
  • Savings milestone badges: gamify reaching ₹10K, ₹50K, ₹1L thresholds.

**Notification strategy:** Weekly 'You saved ₹X more than last week!' push every Sunday evening — positive reinforcement drives retention for this segment.

Impulsive Spender.strategy:
**What makes them unique:** Impulsive Spenders have high income potential but weekend purchase clusters erode savings before month-end.

**Features to build:**
  • Friday evening 'Weekend Budget' alert showing remaining discretionary balance.
  • 'Cool-down timer': 24-hour hold on purchases above ₹2,000 from unknown merchants.

**Notification strategy:** Thursday afternoon nudge — 'Your weekend budget is ₹X. Lock in savings before Friday?' with a one-tap FD shortcut.

Heavy Subscriber.strategy:
**What makes them unique:** Heavy Subscribers commit to many recurring services but rarely audit overlap — they're the highest leakage segment.

**Features to build:**
  • Subscription dashboard: visual timeline of all recurring debits with usage scores.
  • Duplicate-service detector: flag when 2 merchants serve the same need.

**Notification strategy:** Monthly 'Subscription Audit Day' on the 1st — 'You're paying for X services. Here are 2 you haven't used in 30 days.'

Luxury Spender.strategy:
**What makes them unique:** Luxury Spenders have the highest avg transaction value and strong income, but lifestyle inflation creeps up silently.

**Features to build:**
  • Lifestyle inflation tracker: year-on-year comparison of category spend.
  • Premium concierge: curated cashback deals at preferred merchants.

**Notification strategy:** Quarterly 'Net Worth Check-in' — compare asset growth vs spending growth. Frame as status ('You're in the top 15% of savers').

Weekend Shopper.strategy:
**What makes them unique:** Weekend Shoppers concentrate spending on Fri–Sun, making month-end budgets unpredictable.

**Features to build:**
  • Weekend spend forecast: 'Based on past 4 weekends, you'll spend ~₹X this weekend.'
  • Buy-now-pay-later guardrail: block BNPL activation if monthly spend > 80% of budget.

**Notification strategy:** Saturday morning check-in — 'Good morning! Your weekend budget is ₹X. Tap to see last weekend's breakdown.'
